## Why it matters internationally

The Hsu group carries engineered emissivity to wearables and dynamic
materials: fabrics and films whose spectral emissivity is designed, and
can switch, to manage heat for people and buildings — the
human-scale face of radiative-property engineering.

## Scope of activity

- **Quantities:** spectrally engineered emissivity of textiles and films
- **Spectral range:** solar + mid-infrared bands
- **Methodology:** Radiative cooling and heating textiles with engineered emissivity, including spectrally engineered fabric for urban heat (Science 2024); dynamic and dual-mode emissivity materials.

**Application domains:** personal thermal management textiles · dynamic emissivity materials.
